message:
Have you ever found yourself in a situation where you realized you weren’t quite as prepared as you thought? We’ve definitely had our share of funny moments—like the time we tried to change a flat tire with nothing but a coffee cup! 🚗

That’s why we love resources like the one from Ready.gov about car preparedness. It’s a gentle reminder that being ready can save us from a comedic disaster on the road.
